notes: Birch Lane runs on the same @wayfair/sf-ui-core-funnel Next.js platform as Wayfair (confirmed via __FETCH_DATA__ storeDomain/storeID in page source) but is a genuinely distinct storefront/catalogue: storeID 422, vs Wayfair 49, AllModern 81, Joss & Main 450, Perigold 457 (all visible in the site's own cross-brand handover.php nav links) -- this is the platform/catalog-ID verification the brief asked for, so this is NOT treated as a duplicate-company case; rows were fully extracted. Access: plain requests worked for the homepage (HTTP 200) but every category/listing page returned PerimeterX px-captcha (HTTP 429) via plain requests; switched to curl_cffi browser impersonation (chrome profile), which passed cleanly on every fetch with light pacing (1.5-3s between requests, no retries needed). qty is the listing grid's own resultCount value from the page's embedded Next.js RSC payload, cross-checked against the payload's numberOfItems field on every leaf (both agree in all cases; evidence lists both). Category tree was built by crawling the site's own mega-nav plus each 'cat' hub page's in-page subcategory links (top-nav 'cat' pages are pure hub/landing pages with no resultCount of their own; actual product totals live only on 'sb0' leaf listing pages, one exception being Baby & Kids Wall Art which is a cat-type page with no sb0 child and no exposed count -- left null+flagged). Rule 0.6 overlap handling: (1) Mirrors -- 'All Mirrors' umbrella (415) is within noise of Floor & Full Length Mirrors (45) + Wall Mirrors (372) = 417, confirming those two are an exhaustive type-based partition, so the umbrella was dropped and the two types kept as leaves; (2) Wall Art -- Canvas/Framed/Wall Art Sets format-facets sum to only 374 against the 'All Wall Art' umbrella's 466, proving they are non-exhaustive format-facet cuts (not a genuine partition), so the complete umbrella figure was kept as the single Wall Art leaf and the three sub-facets were dropped to avoid under- and over-counting; (3) 'Wall Decor', 'Home Decor' and 'Organizational Decor' cat pages were confirmed to be duplicate re-listings of the same children already captured under Mirrors/Wall Art/Decorative Objects, so no separate rows were added for them. Excluded per brief: all furniture, bath fixtures/vanities/plumbing/storage (except mirrors/lighting), rugs, bedding, curtains/curtain hardware/valances/wallpaper/windows, all textiles (pillows, throws, tablecloths, placemats, kitchen linens), holiday decor (wreaths, garlands), faux/artificial botanicals (Floral Stems & Branches, Plants & Trees), home fragrance (Scents & Diffusers), fireplaces, ceiling fans, light bulbs, wall shelves (storage), cutlery/flatware, bar tools, kitchen appliances/cookware/bakeware/sinks/faucets/hardware/tile/knife storage, trivets, and all NEVER-EXTRACT nav entries (Shop All, Best Sellers, New Arrivals, Sale, Collaborations, Inspiration, etc). Candles (raw total 81) is a mixed scented/unscented roll-up with no scent facet to isolate an exact unscented-only count, so left null+flagged per the ONE RULE THAT MATTERS rather than estimating. Only 2 of 54 leaves are null (Candles, Baby & Kids Wall Art), well under the threshold that would require a 'partial' status, so status is 'ok'.
